LicenseKey.title: LicenseKey
LicenseKey.description: Represents a one-time random activation key for the Hybrid Online/Offline licensing system.

keyCode.description: The formatted one-time random license key string (e.g., MTK-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX).

durationDays.description: Number of validity days granted upon activation (e.g. 1, 7, 30, 90, 365, 36500).

durationLabel.description: Human-readable duration tier label (e.g. 30 Days, 1 Year, Lifetime).

status.description: Current redemption status of the one-time random key.

createdByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator or user session that registered the key.

boundHwid.description: Hardware ID of the device that redeemed this key (empty string when UNUSED).

redeemedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who redeemed this key (empty string when UNUSED).

signatureHex.description: Native C++ HMAC-SHA256 signature proving key authenticity.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the key was created (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the key was last updated (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Represents an authenticated user account bound to username, email, password hash, device model, hwid, and active license.

passwordHash.description: Cryptographically salted hash of the user password.

hwid.description: Hardware ID of the bound device.

deviceModel.description: Device brand and model name (e.g. Xiaomi Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G).

activeKeyCode.description: The active one-time random key assigned to this account.

expiryEpochSec.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the license expires.

offlineCert.description: Cryptographic offline certificate generated by libjin_usb.so for this device.

authUid.description: Firebase Auth UID associated with this account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account was registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when account was last updated.

/license_keys/{keyId}.description: Stores one-time random activation keys indexed by their keyCode.

/user_accounts/{accountId}.description: Stores registered user accounts indexed by deterministic email hash docId.
